tip: In reported speech German uses Konjunktiv I: 'habe' (not 'hat') marks this as her claim, not confirmed fact.
'Innerhalb' takes the genitive: 'innerhalb eines Jahres' (within a year), not 'einem Jahr'.
With separable verbs 'zu' goes between prefix and stem: anrufen becomes 'anzurufen' (an + zu + rufen).
You can drop 'wenn' and lead with the verb: 'Hätten wir angefangen' means the same as 'Wenn wir angefangen hätten'.
'Um ... zu' plus an infinitive expresses purpose: 'Um fit zu bleiben' means in order to stay fit.
